content_blocks.text: Engineering Change Notice ECN-1058 Engineering Change Notice ECN-1058 ECN Number: ECN-1058 Title: Alarm A17 Threshold Reference Correction Effective: Immediately upon publication References: ECN-1042 Status: Released

The Alarm Reference (AEG-AL-700) description for Alarm A17 (Hydraulic Pressure Low) referenced the pre-ECN-1042 pressure sensor (PS-04) by name. This notice corrects that reference: Alarm A17's low-pressure condition is evaluated against whichever pressure sensor is active for the installed software revision (PS-04 prior to revision 3.2, PS-04A on revision 3.2 and later). The alarm's threshold logic itself is unchanged by this notice. This is a documentation correction only. No firmware or hardware change is required.
This notice does not change the operating pressure setpoint established in ECN-1042. ECN-1058 | Page 1
